component.name: Emoji Palette for Fcitx 5
component.summary: Search and insert emoji through Fcitx 5

description.p: Emoji Palette provides a searchable, keyboard-driven emoji picker for Fcitx 5. It commits selections through the original Fcitx input context without modifying the clipboard or simulating input.
The non-activating palette supports English, German, and Russian search, favorites, recent emoji, skin-tone variants, and multi-monitor Wayland placement.
Corrected prerelease publication for Fedora 44 and Bazzite 44.
First public prerelease for Fedora 44 and Bazzite 44.
